q: Do you have a passion for numbers, a sharp analytical mind, and an eye for creating fair, competitive and rewarding employee experiences?
At Boutiqaat, we're looking for a Compensation & Benefits Specialist to join our team and help shape how we attract, reward and retain talent across multiple countries.
You'll play a key role in ensuring our compensation and benefits programs are competitive, equitable, data-driven and aligned with business objectives.

r: Shape Competitive Rewards: Develop salary structures, conduct market benchmarking, evaluate jobs and identify opportunities to strengthen internal equity.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is globally expanding its Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales team, hiring managers, directors, and account managers to broaden reach in mission-critical industries. The successful candidates will focus on our Ubuntu product portfolio, which is already widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer offering, Ubuntu Core for IoT, provides state-of-the-art security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment, serving global brands in consumer, industrial electronics, automotive, and robotics. We are continually enhancing this portfolio with features like real-time Linux capability and pursuing various certifications, representing Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint. We seek technically skilled professionals familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS.

This is a high-energy role focused on prospecting sales and strategic account development, demanding ambition and focus. You will be responsible for carrying an annual bookings quota and must be comfortable positioning and selling a range of open source, services, and software solutions. Leveraging Ubuntu's market adoption, the work requires actively building trusted and profitable commercial relationships, developing the potential of your territory beyond managing inbound interest. This involves prospecting new business, maintaining existing relationships, and working with colleagues on account strategy. Candidates must be effective in selling complex technical solutions, including enterprise software, cloud, virtualization, and container technologies, to senior levels of the enterprise and departments focused on embedded software and IoT devices. Professional practice, clear account planning, continuous pipeline reporting, and the ability to travel regionally for client engagement and internationally for company events twice a year are expected.
Location: We are growing our sales reach with remote roles in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas; and office based roles in Taipei, Taiwan.
Building and executing a territory sales plan to prioritize leading security-focused brands and manufacturers
Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts
Developing pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
Closing contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets and achieve strategic objectives
Managing customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
Working with Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction
Maintaining accurate data and forecasts within Salesforce
Establishing productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision-makers
Coordinating with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

d: The Executive Director, Client Coverage, Public Sector is the strategic adviser and relationship lead for a portfolio of major public sector clients, primarily across the Middle East and Pakistan. The portfolio includes central banks, ministries of finance, government entities and agencies, export credit and development agencies, multilateral organisations, regional development banks and selected development organisations. The role is accountable for developing senior client relationships, originating and delivering relevant solutions across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking, and achieving sustainable revenues and returns while maintaining strong credit, financial crime, conduct and regulatory risk discipline. The role also supports the regional team head on origination and client engagement across the region and selectively develops approved prospect relationships.
Lead client strategies through disciplined account planning and deliver agreed revenue, profitability, RoRWA and franchise objectives for the designated portfolio.

Build senior relationships up to ministerial and C-suite level, anticipate client needs, originate new business and position the Bank as a consistent strategic partner rather than a transactional provider.

Mobilise Transaction Banking, Financial Markets, Global Banking, structuring, advisory and industry partners to deliver relevant solutions, deepen inbound flows and selectively deploy balance sheet where supported by appropriate ancillary returns and Group economics.
Originate and structure sustainable finance solutions including debt-for-nature, debt-for-development and sustainable loans, and replicate successful structures across the public sector segment.

Own client acceptance and ongoing risk management, including AML, CDD and credit; maintain accurate account plans, call reports and deal pipelines; identify, escalate and resolve conduct, regulatory, reputational and credit issues.

Maintain strong knowledge of political, macroeconomic, country-risk and industry developments; bring international best practice, investment opportunities and thought leadership to clients; support investor roadshows, RFPs and industry engagement.

Maintain effective relationships with Country and Cluster leadership, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Client Management and product teams; ensure timely meeting notes, coordinated execution and high-quality client outcomes across the Bank network.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. The role holder is expected to contribute to team capability, knowledge sharing, diversity initiatives and the development of colleagues through informal coaching and collaboration.
Operate as a senior individual contributor, providing leadership through client judgement, execution discipline and collaboration across the regional Public Sector franchise.
Invest in personal development, share knowledge and support the development of colleagues through coaching, inclusive teamwork and participation in learning and diversity initiatives.
Maintain mandatory learning, professional development and risk-awareness standards applicable to the role.
Share sector, thematic and market insights with clients and internal partners to strengthen strategic engagement and the Bank’s market position.
Strategic client impact: Energised by solving complex public sector priorities and building trusted relationships with senior government, central bank and development-institution stakeholders.
Origination and innovation: Motivated by creating commercially sound, differentiated solutions across financing, markets, transaction banking and sustainable finance.
International collaboration: Thrives in a cross-border environment that requires judgement, resilience, teamwork and effective mobilisation of the Bank’s network.
q: 10+ years of relevant banking experience, preferably in senior relationship management, origination or sales covering public sector, sovereign, financial institution or development-finance clients.
Demonstrated experience managing complex client relationships, originating cross-product opportunities and coordinating execution across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Banking, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline preferred.
Strong knowledge of credit, AML, CDD, conduct and regulatory requirements. Any market-specific licence required to undertake banking business must be maintained.
Arabic or other relevant regional language capability is advantageous.
